pr_title: [Fix #7170] Fix a false positive in `Layout/RescueEnsureAlignment` cop
pr_body:
Fixes #7170.

The `Layout/RescueEnsureAlignment` would register an offense when `private_class_method` and def are on the same line as below:

```console
$ cat foo.rb
private_class_method def self.foo
  puts 'foo'
rescue StandardError
  puts 'bar'
end
$
```

```console
$ rubocop --only 'Layout/RescueEnsureAlignment' foo.rb
Inspecting 1 file
C

Offenses:

foo.rb:3:1: C: Layout/RescueEnsureAlignment: rescue at 3, 0 is not aligned with def self.foo at 1, 21.
rescue StandardError
^^^^^^

1 file inspected, 1 offense detected
$
```

This change makes sure the cop recognizes def lines preceded with private_class_method.

issue_context.title: Layout/RescueEnsureAlignment doesn't behave as expected with inline private_class_method
issue_context.body:
Rubocop reports a warning, when I think it shouldn't.


--------

## Expected behavior
I expect no warnings for this example. Also, autocorrection should align this method as it is:
```ruby
private_class_method def self.parse(_foo)
  puts 'hi'
rescue StandardError
  puts 'do nothing'
end
```

## Actual behavior


This is the warning I get:
```
Inspecting 1 file
C

Offenses:

tests.rb:5:1: C: Layout/RescueEnsureAlignment: rescue at 5, 0 is not aligned with def self.parse at 3, 21.
rescue StandardError
^^^^^^

1 file inspected, 1 offense detected
```
And this the autocorrection:
```ruby
# frozen_string_literal: true

private_class_method def self.parse(_foo)
  puts 'hi'
                     rescue StandardError
                       puts 'do nothing'
end
```

## Steps to reproduce the problem

Already described

## RuboCop version

```
0.71.0 (using Parser 2.6.3.0, running on ruby 2.5.3 x86_64-darwin17)
```

review_comments: This expected behavior may be more clearer by writing a spec of `public_class_method`.
